title: A catch parameter replaces a previously null local with the caught exception

ground_truth.statement: A catch parameter replaces a previously null local with the caught exception. The exception consumer in that catch is sound.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. The catch consumer returns string rather than an unnecessarily nullable string, so the case does not collect unrelated unused-null-return diagnostics. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
